name: Metformin
description: A commonly used medicine for type 2 diabetes that helps lower blood glucose.
howItWorks: It reduces glucose production by the liver and improves the body's response to insulin.
precautions: Use according to the prescribed plan.
Kidney function may need monitoring during long-term treatment.
storage: Store at room temperature away from excessive heat and moisture.

name: Gliclazide
description: An oral medicine used to help control blood glucose in some people with type 2 diabetes.
howItWorks: It stimulates the pancreas to release more insulin.
precautions: Use only as prescribed.
Low blood sugar can occur, especially if meals are missed.
storage: Store at room temperature in a dry place.

name: Sitagliptin
description: An oral medicine used in type 2 diabetes to help improve blood glucose control.
howItWorks: It increases incretin activity, helping regulate insulin and glucagon after meals.
precautions: Use according to the prescribed instructions.
Dose adjustments may be needed in people with reduced kidney function.
storage: Store at room temperature away from moisture.

name: Empagliflozin
description: A medicine used in type 2 diabetes and in selected patients with heart failure or chronic kidney disease.
commonUses: Chronic kidney disease in selected patients
howItWorks: It causes the kidneys to remove more glucose and sodium through the urine.
precautions: Use only as prescribed.
Adequate hydration and kidney monitoring may be important.
storage: Store at room temperature away from excessive moisture.

name: Amlodipine
description: A medicine commonly used to lower blood pressure and treat certain heart-related conditions.
howItWorks: It relaxes blood vessels, helping blood flow more easily and lowering blood pressure.
precautions: Use according to the prescribed plan.
Report significant swelling, fainting, or persistent dizziness to a healthcare professional.
storage: Store at room temperature away from heat and moisture.

name: Losartan
description: A blood pressure medicine also used in some people with heart or kidney conditions.
commonUses: Kidney protection in selected patients with diabetes
howItWorks: It blocks the effects of angiotensin II, helping blood vessels relax.
precautions: Use only as prescribed.
Blood pressure, kidney function, and potassium may need monitoring.
storage: Store at room temperature and protect from moisture.

name: Lisinopril
description: A medicine used for high blood pressure, heart failure, and selected kidney-related conditions.
howItWorks: It reduces formation of angiotensin II, helping blood vessels relax and reducing strain on the heart.
precautions: Use according to the prescribed plan.
Seek urgent medical help for swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat.
storage: Store at room temperature away from moisture.

name: Hydrochlorothiazide
description: A diuretic commonly used to help lower blood pressure and reduce excess fluid.
howItWorks: It helps the kidneys remove sodium and water from the body.
precautions: Use according to the prescribed instructions.
Blood pressure and electrolyte levels may need monitoring.
storage: Store at room temperature away from moisture and excessive heat.

name: Furosemide
description: A diuretic used to remove excess fluid in conditions such as heart failure and edema.
howItWorks: It acts on the kidneys to increase removal of sodium and water.
precautions: Use only as prescribed.
Weight, kidney function, and electrolytes may need monitoring.
storage: Store at room temperature and protect from excessive light and moisture.

name: Carvedilol
description: A medicine used for certain cardiovascular conditions including heart failure and high blood pressure.
howItWorks: It blocks certain receptors in the heart and blood vessels, reducing heart rate and helping blood vessels relax.
precautions: Take according to the prescribed instructions.
Do not stop suddenly unless directed by the prescribing healthcare professional.
storage: Store at room temperature away from excessive heat and moisture.

name: Metoprolol
description: A beta blocker used for selected heart conditions and high blood pressure.
howItWorks: It slows the heart rate and reduces the heart's workload.
precautions: Use only as prescribed.
Do not stop suddenly without medical advice.
storage: Store at room temperature away from moisture.

name: Atorvastatin
description: A cholesterol-lowering medicine used to reduce cardiovascular risk in appropriate patients.
howItWorks: It reduces cholesterol production in the liver and lowers LDL cholesterol.
precautions: Use according to the prescribed plan.
Report unexplained severe muscle pain or weakness.
storage: Store at room temperature away from excessive heat and moisture.

name: Rosuvastatin
description: A statin medicine used to lower cholesterol and reduce cardiovascular risk in appropriate patients.
howItWorks: It reduces cholesterol production in the liver and increases removal of LDL cholesterol from the blood.
precautions: Use only as prescribed.
Report unexplained severe muscle pain or weakness.
storage: Store at room temperature away from moisture.

name: Clopidogrel
description: An antiplatelet medicine that helps reduce the formation of harmful blood clots.
commonUses: Prevention of certain cardiovascular events in appropriate patients
howItWorks: It reduces the ability of platelets to stick together and form clots.
precautions: Tell healthcare professionals that this medicine is being taken before procedures or surgery.
Seek medical attention for serious or unusual bleeding.
storage: Store at room temperature away from excessive moisture.

name: Levothyroxine
description: A synthetic thyroid hormone used when the body does not produce enough thyroid hormone.
howItWorks: It replaces or supplements thyroid hormone normally produced by the thyroid gland.
commonSideEffects: Palpitations if dose is too high
precautions: Take exactly as prescribed.
Timing in relation to food and other medicines can affect absorption.
storage: Store at room temperature away from excessive heat, light, and moisture.

name: Salbutamol
description: A quick-relief bronchodilator used to ease bronchospasm and breathing difficulty.
howItWorks: It relaxes airway muscles, helping the airways open.
precautions: Use according to the prescribed inhaler plan.
Needing rescue inhaler doses more often than usual may indicate worsening breathing control.
storage: Store according to inhaler labeling; protect from excessive heat.

name: Budesonide/Formoterol
description: A combination inhaler used for long-term control of asthma and selected patients with COPD.
howItWorks: Budesonide reduces airway inflammation while formoterol relaxes airway muscles.
precautions: Use according to the prescribed inhaler plan.
Rinsing the mouth after use can help reduce oral thrush risk.
storage: Store as directed on the inhaler label and protect from excessive heat.

name: Tiotropium
description: A long-acting inhaled medicine used to help keep the airways open in chronic respiratory disease.
howItWorks: It blocks certain airway receptors that cause bronchial muscle tightening.
precautions: Use only as prescribed.
This is generally a maintenance medicine rather than a rapid-relief treatment.
storage: Store according to product labeling and keep dry.

name: Omeprazole
description: A medicine that reduces stomach acid and is used for chronic acid-related conditions.
howItWorks: It blocks an enzyme in stomach cells involved in producing stomach acid.
precautions: Follow the prescribed instructions and treatment duration.
Discuss prolonged use with a healthcare professional.
storage: Store at room temperature away from heat and moisture.

name: Allopurinol
description: A medicine used for long-term reduction of uric acid in conditions such as gout.
howItWorks: It reduces production of uric acid in the body.
precautions: Use according to the prescribed plan.
Seek medical attention promptly for a new or severe rash.
storage: Store at room temperature away from moisture.
